points: Best of 14 tested models chose correctly in 59.7% of forks (arXiv 2609.25804, unreviewed)
When the deciding evidence appears late, accuracy falls to about 21%
A larger reasoning budget did not improve accuracy
read: Episode show notes and arXiv abstract
take: Taste-Bench tests agents' intermediate choices, not just outcomes. Long-horizon judgement remains weak, a caution for unsupervised agent workflows.
title: heise KI-Update: best agent picks better path only 60% of time
